card.name: Inside capitalized EMBRYO-FETAL warnings
card.fires_on: The letter O at the end of EMBRY in all-caps EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY boxed warning headings. It also fires partway through other all-caps long words.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL heading
modes.description: The O completing EMBRY in the all-caps boxed warning title EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIOMYOPATHY, INFUSION REACTIONS, EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY,

modes.label: Other all-caps long words
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a long uppercase word such as WATERSHEDS or AGGRAVATE.
